tokens.name: bg-0
tokens.usage: App background behind everything; the calendar grid's ground.

tokens.name: bg-1
tokens.usage: Sidebar, top bar and calendar day cells.

tokens.name: bg-2
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: popovers, cards, stat tiles, inputs, detail rows.

tokens.name: bg-3
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fills, segmented-control track, selected nav row.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: calendar grid, dividers, card edges. Decorative only — never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, selects and secondary buttons (3:1 on bg-1 and bg-2).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and event titles on bg-0 through bg-3.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: times, labels, section headings, inactive nav on bg-0 through bg-3.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: day numbers of other months, hints. Only on bg-0, bg-1 and bg-2.

tokens.name: spotlight
tokens.usage: THE brand color — stage-light yellow. Fill of the one primary action per view, the active segment, the selected nav marker. Never body text on light grounds.

tokens.name: on-spotlight
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a spotlight fill.

tokens.name: spotlight-ink
tokens.usage: Spotlight as text: active nav label, links, today's date number.

tokens.name: spotlight-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the active nav row and the today cell.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px outline on every focused control, offset 2px; ≥3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: hot
tokens.usage: Unread counts (chat, requests) and the 'New' tag. Counts only — never an event status.

tokens.name: on-hot
tokens.usage: Text on a hot fill.

tokens.name: status-pending
tokens.usage: Pending events: label text, icon and chip border tint. Always paired with the word 'Pending'.

tokens.name: status-pending-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of a pending event chip.

tokens.name: status-confirmed
tokens.usage: Confirmed events (the gig is happening). Always paired with the word 'Confirmed'.

tokens.name: status-confirmed-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of a confirmed event chip.

tokens.name: status-paid
tokens.usage: Paid events (client payment received). Always paired with the word 'Paid'.

tokens.name: status-paid-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of a paid event chip.

tokens.name: status-cancelled
tokens.usage: Cancelled events and destructive actions (delete event). Always paired with a word.

tokens.name: status-cancelled-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of a cancelled event chip and the danger button hover.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Page titles: the month on Calendar, the band name on its landing page.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Popover and dialog titles, event name on its detail page.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Pay is split among the members who played.
styles.usage: Default UI text, form values, table cells.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Nav labels, button labels, event titles inside chips.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Status labels in chips, weekday headers, badges.

styles.name: num
styles.usage: Durations, amounts in tables, song keys; tabular figures.

tokens.name: space-0-5
tokens.usage: Gap between a chip's status line and its title.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap in chips and badges.

tokens.name: space-1-5
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked event chips in a day cell; chip vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap in buttons; day cell padding; chip horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding; nav row padding; detail-row padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card and popover padding; gap between toolbar groups.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Sidebar horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page gutter; gap between dashboard tiles.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between page sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Landing page section rhythm.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Event chips, detail rows, badges with text.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, selects, square icon buttons, nav rows.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Popovers, cards, stat tiles.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the app frame on the landing page.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, segmented controls, count badges, top-bar chips.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Popovers, menus, dialogs — the only elevated layer.

tokens.name: shadow-glow
tokens.usage: Halo on the primary button when hovered.
